sections.headline: Modern Life May Be Working Against Your Hair
sections.body: Today's chronic stress, processed diets, and environmental toxins can quietly disrupt your body's natural hormonal balance and follicle health. Many people don't get enough beneficial plant compounds from diet alone — making it harder for follicles to stay active and resilient. The result can be increased shedding, a receding hairline, or thinning at the crown — often linked to elevated DHT and oxidative stress on the scalp.
bullets: Elevated DHT miniaturizes follicles over time
Nutrient gaps leave follicles undernourished
Oxidative stress weakens the scalp environment

sections.headline: The Ancient Seed Nature Uses to Defend Hair from Within
sections.body: Often called "Nature's Follicle Guardian," pumpkin seed oil has been used for generations to support hormonal balance and natural hair resilience. Lumora pairs it with saw palmetto for a dual-action approach — pumpkin seed's phytosterols help support healthy DHT levels while saw palmetto works on both production and receptor activity, together helping protect active follicles and support dormant ones.
bullets: Dual-action DHT support from root to strand
Phytosterols help protect follicles from miniaturization
Saw palmetto addresses both production and receptor activity

faqs.question: Where can I buy Lumora Pumpkin Seed Oil Softgels?
faqs.answer: Lumora Pumpkin Seed Oil Softgels are available exclusively through our official website. This ensures the highest quality, freshness, and best pricing for every order.

faqs.question: What ingredients are in Lumora?
faqs.answer: Each softgel contains cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil (Cucurbita pepo) blended with saw palmetto extract. No fillers, no artificial additives, no preservatives — just clean, plant-based support.

faqs.question: How long until I notice a difference?
faqs.answer: Many customers notice a calmer scalp and less shedding within the first few weeks. Visible baby hairs and fuller-looking strands typically appear with continued daily use over 2 to 6 months. Consistency delivers the best results.

faqs.question: Is Lumora safe to take with my current medications?
faqs.answer: Lumora Pumpkin Seed Oil is generally safe for daily use. It's always best to consult your healthcare provider before starting any new supplement — especially if you take medications or have existing health concerns.

faqs.question: How should I take Lumora Pumpkin Seed Oil Softgels?
faqs.answer: Take 2 softgels daily with food, or as directed by your healthcare provider. Consistent daily use provides the best long-term support for your hair and scalp.

faqs.question: What is your return policy?
faqs.answer: If you're not satisfied with Lumora Pumpkin Seed Oil, contact us within 30 days of receiving your order and we'll guide you through the easy return process. Your satisfaction is our top priority.
